decision.reasoning_trace: I was primarily looking for a mid-sized hiking backpack with a balance of durability and lightweight design. The HIKPRO 20L is a great price but seems too unstructured for longer hikes. The Maxpedition is high quality but too expensive for my current budget. The tactical options (Explorer and Warriors Product) are a bit too niche in style and heavy for my needs. The hydration pack from NEVO RHINO had several reviews mentioning bladder failure, which is a major concern for my use case. Since none of the options perfectly met my criteria for a general-purpose outdoor backpack, I decided to hold off on a purchase.
